purpose: Verify the contained-footer correction and persist decisive geometry without forwarding Support traffic.

environment.responses: local interception of public support session/message routes

transcript.prompt: La ce folosește panoul Spațiu de lucru?

preCaptureIdentity: Exactly one new assistant article appended for the requested row.
Article text equals intercepted API text and saved row text.
Rendered source labels and actions equal the current row's payload.
Row23 selects the export article and its two source labels, never an earlier article.
persistBeforeThrow: before/top/pre-footer/post-footer target, pane and footer floating-point rectangles
prior, requested, assigned and realized scrollTop
scrollHeight, clientHeight, maximum scroll and requested delta
containment/intersection decisions and explicit tolerance or margin
failure code and exclusive-created failure artifact
controls: Old helper reproduces unnecessary backward movement or the row23 failure.
Corrected helper preserves an already-contained row23 footer and captures it.
A genuinely below-pane footer scrolls forward and becomes painted inside the pane.
An unreachable or clipped footer still fails.
Stale target and source/action mutations fail before capture.
Styles, scroll and viewport restore on both success and failure.
